_meta.note: Pass/fail against the four hard filters in profiles.json, applied to all 50 candidates. `fails` lists every filter the candidate misses; an empty list means it reaches scoring. Reasons are the specific fact that decides it, not a judgement.
_meta.result: 15 of 50 pass all four. The report scores those 15 plus 5 pay-as-you-go options carried forward deliberately as overflow capacity, for a shortlist of 20.

opencode-go.reason: flat $10/mo, dollar-denominated quota published per model, Anthropic- and OpenAI-compatible

zai-glm-coding.reason: flat $18-$168, weekly credit quota published, native Anthropic endpoint

synthetic-new.reason: flat $30, 500 messages per 5h published, native Anthropic compatibility

cerebras-code.reason: flat $50/$200 quoted directly in tokens per day

minimax-token-plan.reason: flat $10-$150 with published requests per 5h per tier

kimi-code.reason: flat $19-$199, 5h window refreshing weekly, Anthropic endpoint

nous-portal.reason: flat $20/$100 with credit amounts and RPM/TPM published

venice.reason: flat $18-$200 with a credit quota and published per-model API rates

stepfun-step-plan.reason: flat $6.99-$99 with prompts per 5h published per tier

xiaomi-mimo-plan.reason: flat ~$6-$100 with credit and estimated-task counts published

alibaba-coding-plan.reason: flat CNY 200/mo Coding Plan, Anthropic-compatible DashScope endpoint

llmgateway-devpass.reason: flat $29-$179 with a stated provider-rate value ceiling

cohere-command-code.reason: flat $15/$100 credit plan on an OpenAI-compatible endpoint

factory-droid.reason: flat $20-$200 with token allowances per tier

anthropic-claude-max.reason: since 2026-01-09 subscription OAuth tokens are rejected outside Claude Code and Claude.ai; the error is `This credential is only authorized for use with Claude Code`. Anthropic states use with any other product, including the Agent SDK, violates consumer terms.

openai-codex-chatgpt.reason: Codex quota is bound to the ChatGPT client and CLI; API access is billed separately

google-ai-pro-ultra.reason: raised limits apply to Gemini CLI and Code Assist, not to a portable API key

github-copilot.reason: IDE-bound; 300 premium requests/month is roughly two hours of agent work

cursor.reason: usage is spendable only inside the Cursor editor

windsurf.reason: editor-bound, and credit-to-token conversion is unpublished

jetbrains-ai.reason: capacity is attached to a JetBrains IDE seat

warp.reason: credentials bound to the Warp binary

ollama-cloud.reason: quota is stated only as `50x Free` and `5x Pro`, where Free is itself undefined; Max signups are paused

nanogpt.reason: the $12 subscription's entitlement and the retention policy are both unpublished

iflow-cli.reason: free tier with undisclosed daily caps and undisclosed retention

featherless.reason: tool calling unreliable across the catalogue, and the $25 unlimited plan caps context at 32K

uncensored-chat.reason: no tool calling, and neither limits nor retention are published

wiro-ai.reason: no tool calling; model provenance claims unverifiable

perplexity-sonar.reason: no tool calling — retrieval is the product, but the model cannot act

thedrummer-class.reason: measured across OpenRouter, this family advertises no tool support and caps at 32K-131K context

hermes-4.reason: OpenRouter endpoints for both 70B and 405B advertise no tool support

mistral-api.reason: the $14.99 flat plan is Le Chat, a chat product; API capacity is PAYG

opencode-zen.reason: pure pay-as-you-go — carried forward as overflow capacity

deepseek-api.reason: pay-as-you-go — carried forward as overflow capacity

zai-api.reason: pay-as-you-go — carried forward as overflow capacity

xai-grok-api.reason: pay-as-you-go — carried forward as the permissive frontier reference

openrouter.reason: pay-as-you-go — carried forward as the routing and measurement layer

anthropic-api.reason: pay-as-you-go; also the strictest moderation posture in the survey

google-gemini-api.reason: pay-as-you-go; account-specific limits are not published as tables

siliconflow.reason: pay-as-you-go; documented as not serving thinking variants

amazon-bedrock.reason: pay-as-you-go; adds a mandatory Guardrails surface

thinkingmachines-inkling.reason: free tier only; no durable plan

vllm-selfhost.reason: hourly GPU rental is not a plan; ~$1,300/month continuous for one 96GB card

ollama-local.reason: no plan; free and local, several capability tiers below the requirement
